_comment: Per-model prices in USD per 1M tokens. Patterns are fnmatch globs, matched
against the bare model id after any provider prefix is stripped; the most
specific (longest) matching pattern wins, so a dated snapshot beats its family.
A model absent from this table costs `null` — unknown — never zero.
Override or extend with the `agent.modelPricing` setting; that is merged over
this file, so a stale entry here can always be corrected without a release.
